# CWE-250: Execution with Unnecessary Privileges — IaC Detection Guide

## Core Principle
The weakness centers on the **violation of least privilege**: any resource, service, or process configured with more access than its function requires. In IaC, this is typically expressed through configuration fields rather than code logic.

---

## Weakness Categories & Indicators

### 1. Containers / Processes Running as Root
Containers or services configured to run as the root user or with UID 0.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Running as root explicitly | `user: root`, `runAsUser: 0`, `USER root` |
| Root not enforced | `runAsNonRoot: false`, absence of `runAsNonRoot` |
| No UID/GID constraint | Missing `runAsUser`, `runAsGroup`, `fsGroup` |

---

### 2. Privileged Execution Mode
Granting a container or task near-full host-level access.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Privileged flag | `privileged: true` |
| Privilege escalation allowed | `allowPrivilegeEscalation: true` |
| No drop of privileges | Absence of `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false` |

---

### 3. Excessive Linux / OS Capabilities
Adding system-level capabilities beyond what the workload needs.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| All capabilities granted | `capabilities.add: ["ALL"]` |
| Dangerous specific capabilities | `SYS_ADMIN`, `NET_ADMIN`, `SYS_PTRACE`, `NET_RAW`, `SYS_MODULE`, `SYS_CHROOT`, `DAC_OVERRIDE`, `SETUID`, `SETGID` |
| No capability dropping | Absence of `capabilities.drop: ["ALL"]` |

---

### 4. Overly Permissive IAM / RBAC Policies
Policies that grant broad permissions rather than scoped, task-specific ones.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Wildcard actions | `Action: "*"`, `actions: ["*"]` |
| Wildcard resources | `Resource: "*"`, `resource: "*"` |
| Blanket allow | `Effect: Allow` combined with wildcards |
| Managed admin policies | `AdministratorAccess`, `FullAccess`, `PowerUser` |
| Inverted logic (allows everything except) | `NotAction`, `NotResource` |
| Admin roles assigned broadly | `cluster-admin`, `system:masters`, `admin` in role bindings |

---

### 5. Host Namespace Sharing
Sharing host-level namespaces with containers grants them elevated visibility and access.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Host process namespace | `hostPID: true` |
| Host IPC namespace | `hostIPC: true` |
| Host network namespace | `hostNetwork: true` |

---

### 6. Missing or Insufficient Security Context
Absence of security constraints implicitly permits elevated behavior.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| No security context defined | Absence of `securityContext` block |
| Writable root filesystem | `readOnlyRootFilesystem: false`, absence of `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` |
| No seccomp profile | Missing `seccompProfile`, `seccompProfile.type: Unconfined` |
| No AppArmor/SELinux profile | Missing `appArmorProfile`, `seLinuxOptions` |

---

### 7. Over-Permissive Network Rules / Security Groups
Network-level over-privilege can expose services unnecessarily.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Open inbound from all sources | `cidr: 0.0.0.0/0`, `cidr: ::/0` on ingress |
| All ports open | `port: -1`, `fromPort: 0, toPort: 65535` |
| Unrestricted egress | `0.0.0.0/0` on egress without scope |

---

### 8. Privileged Host Path / Volume Mounts
Mounting sensitive host paths gives containers unnecessary host-level access.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Arbitrary host path mounts | `hostPath`, `path: /`, `path: /etc`, `path: /var/run/docker.sock` |
| Writable sensitive mounts | `readOnly: false` on system paths |
| Docker socket exposure | `/var/run/docker.sock`, `/run/docker.sock` |

---

### 9. Unrestricted Sudo / Admin Access Configuration
Configurations that grant unconditional elevated shell access.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Passwordless sudo all commands | `NOPASSWD: ALL`, `ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL` |
| User added to privileged groups | `sudo`, `wheel`, `docker`, `adm` group membership without necessity |

---

### 10. Over-Privileged Service Accounts
Service accounts bound to roles that exceed their functional requirements.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Broad role binding | Binding a service account to `cluster-admin`, `admin`, or wildcard roles |
| Default service account usage | `automountServiceAccountToken: true` without explicit scoped role |
| Admin database users | `username: root`, `username: sa`, `username: admin` for service connections |

---

### 11. Excessive File/Resource Permissions
Assigning overly permissive access modes to files, directories, or objects.

| Indicator Type | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| World-writable permissions | `mode: 0777`, `chmod 777`, `fileMode: 0666` |
| Setuid/setgid bits | `setuid`, `setgid`, `suid` in file permission settings |
| Public access to storage | `acl: public-read-write`, `publicAccessBlock: false`, `blockPublicAccess: false` |

---

## Summary Table

| Weakness Signal | Key IaC Attribute Pattern |
|---|---|
| Root execution | `runAsUser: 0`, `user: root`, no `runAsNonRoot` |
| Privileged mode | `privileged: true`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: true` |
| Excess capabilities | `add: ["ALL"]`, dangerous cap names |
| Wildcard permissions | `Action/*Resource: "*"`, `Effect: Allow` + wildcard |
| Host namespace sharing | `hostPID/hostIPC/hostNetwork: true` |
| No security context | Missing `securityContext`, `seccompProfile: Unconfined` |
| Open network rules | `0.0.0.0/0` on ingress, all-port ranges |
| Sensitive volume mounts | `hostPath` pointing to system directories |
| Unconditional sudo | `NOPASSWD: ALL` |
| Over-privileged accounts | `cluster-admin` bindings, default service accounts |
| Broad file permissions | `0777`, `public-read-write`, `setuid` |

package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

dangerous_caps := {"ALL", "SYS_ADMIN", "NET_ADMIN", "SYS_PTRACE", "NET_RAW", "SYS_MODULE", "SYS_CHROOT", "DAC_OVERRIDE", "SETUID", "SETGID"}

host_ns_attrs := {"hostpid", "hostipc", "hostnetwork", "host_pid", "host_ipc", "host_network"}

wildcard_perm_attrs := {"action", "actions", "resource", "resources"}

sensitive_paths_set := {"/", "/var/run/docker.sock", "/run/docker.sock"}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == "user"
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    lower(attr.value.value) == "root"
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with Unnecessary Privileges - Container running as root user. (CWE-250)"
    }
}
